mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id AS userId, a.store_id AS storeId, s.name AS storeName, a.create_time AS createTime FROM t_user_store_auth a LEFT JOIN t_store s ON s.id = a.store_id AND s.status = 1 WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM t_user_store_auth WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
